description: This file defines the 'Setting' model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to interact with store settings in the database such as retrieving, editing, and deleting configurations.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: This class manages store settings in the database, including retrieval, update, and deletion operations.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all setting records for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves settings data for a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates or inserts settings data for a given code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes all settings for a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings entries with a specific code across all store IDs.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings entries for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single setting value for a given key and store ID.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates a specific setting's value for a given code, key, and store ID.
